The '''Haven system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained a small [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] called [[Haven (planetoid)|Haven]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> and a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was a [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]], both of which were important bases of operations for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Haven (planetoid)|Haven]] served as the site of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] primary resistance center in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] regrouped at a [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] in the Haven [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Following his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] received his [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] [[Limb/Legends|hand]] while in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planetoid Haven.<ref name="TCSWE" />
